```yaml
name: Agent Board Integration

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 * * * *' # Run every hour
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  board-sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Query board for unblocked TODO tasks
        id: query_board
        run: |
          cargo run --bin agent-board-query -- --board-url ${{ secrets.GITHUB_PROJECTS_URL }} --token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN }}

      - name: Claim task
        if: steps.query_board.outputs.task_id != ''
        run: |
          cargo run --bin agent-board-claim -- --task-id ${{ steps.query_board.outputs.task_id }} --token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN }}

      - name: Execute task
        if: steps.query_board.outputs.task_id != ''
        run: |
          cargo run --bin agent-board-execute -- --task-id ${{ steps.query_board.outputs.task_id }} --token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Release task
        if: steps.query_board.outputs.task_id != ''
        run: |
          cargo run --bin agent-board-release -- --task-id ${{ steps.query_board.outputs.task_id }} --token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN }}
```
